title: Shopify Discord Agent — GitHub Promo
characterLock: Same professional man from the reference image, exact face and likeness, navy hoodie, confident presenter, photorealistic, clean corporate lighting, orange and teal accent highlights.

scenes.title: Hook
scenes.dialogue: Running a Shopify store means jumping between admin screens for every quick question. Shopify Discord Agent fixes that — ask your store in plain English, right from Discord.
scenes.visualPrompt: Medium shot, same professional man from reference image at a modern dark desk, subtle Discord and Shopify logos glowing on monitors behind him, slow dolly in, 1080p cinematic corporate style, orange rim light, teal screen accents.

scenes.title: Problem
scenes.dialogue: Stock checks, revenue, orders, discounts — your team shouldn't need five tabs and a login every time.
scenes.visualPrompt: Camera pans to split-screen of cluttered Shopify admin UI morphing into a clean Discord chat window, avatar gestures at the transition, same face and wardrobe, smooth motion.

scenes.title: Architecture
scenes.dialogue: Here's the stack: Discord bridge, n8n AI agent, Gemini on Vertex, and a custom MCP server with twenty-nine Shopify tools.
scenes.visualPrompt: Animated diagram overlay: Discord → n8n → Gemini → MCP → Shopify Admin API, avatar points along the flow, dark tech office, teal connection lines, orange nodes.

scenes.title: Read tools demo
scenes.dialogue: Try: What's the stock for BB-TONER-200? Or: How much revenue today? The agent calls live GraphQL and answers in seconds.
scenes.visualPrompt: Over-shoulder shot of Discord message appearing, then Shopify inventory and revenue cards materializing on screen, avatar nods, photorealistic UI mockups.

scenes.title: Write tools demo
scenes.dialogue: Create discount codes, draft orders, send invoices, update inventory — all through natural language.
scenes.visualPrompt: Avatar types in Discord; coupon code LOVE and draft order confirmation animate on monitor, professional satisfied expression, shallow depth of field.

scenes.title: Safety
scenes.dialogue: High-risk actions use a CONFIRM flow. Deploy read-only mode for safe demos, or mock mode with zero credentials.
scenes.visualPrompt: CONFIRM token dialog appears in chat UI, avatar holds up hand in 'wait' gesture then thumbs up, safety-green accent on UI element.

scenes.title: Docker quick start
scenes.dialogue: One command: docker compose up. Import the n8n workflow, add your Discord token, and you're live — or run mock mode instantly.
scenes.visualPrompt: Terminal with npm run docker:mock and green health checks, Docker containers icon row, avatar smiles at camera, clean dev setup aesthetic.

scenes.title: Tool breadth
scenes.dialogue: Search orders, fulfill shipments, cancel, refund, low-stock alerts, abandoned carts — one conversational interface.
scenes.visualPrompt: Quick montage within scene: order list, fulfillment badge, refund receipt flash on screens, avatar confident presenter pose, energetic but professional.

scenes.title: CTA
scenes.dialogue: Open source, MIT licensed. Star it on GitHub and ship store ops in chat.
scenes.visualPrompt: Avatar faces camera directly, GitHub star animation overlay, project title Shopify Discord Agent in clean sans-serif, warm closing smile, static hold for trim.
